description: This file defines the syntax highlighting mode for Haskell-Literate files in CodeMirror, a code editor component. It sets up the mode by composing it from the base Haskell mode and adds special handling for literate Haskell syntax, where lines starting with '>' are considered code and others are comments.

methods.name: CodeMirror.defineMode
methods.description: Defines a new editing mode named 'haskell-literate' which handles syntax highlighting for literate Haskell files.

methods.name: CodeMirror.getMode
methods.description: Retrieves the base Haskell mode used for tokenization inside literate blocks.

methods.name: CodeMirror.startState
methods.description: Initializes the starting state for the mode, including whether the current line is code or comment, and the base mode's state.

methods.name: CodeMirror.defineMIME
methods.description: Associates the MIME type 'text/x-literate-haskell' with the 'haskell-literate' mode for automatic mode selection.
